# chameleon_contract_quality_history (Data Source)

Fetch all quality run results for a contract.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_contract_quality_history" "orders_runs" {
  contract_id = "5f7c8b53-1f1e-4f8b-92dc-9c3d7c8a4d20"
}

output "orders_dq_history" {
  value = data.chameleon_contract_quality_history.orders_runs.runs
}
```
